title.narrative: Upholding children's Right to education in oPt, a comprehensive approach to promote inclusion, quality, equity, safety and access to education for children in marginalised communities in Gaza.

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to promote the Right to Education for children and education stakeholders in the occupied Palestinian territory (oPt). The specific objective of the Action is to improve inclusion, quality, equity, safety and access to education for children in marginalized communities in Gaza.
